title: Logarithmic gravity from a very slow roll limit of inflation
summary: We study the inflationary no-boundary wavefunction in a ``linear-roll limit,'' in which $G_N \to 0$ while the Hubble scale $H$ and the slope of the inflaton potential are held fixed. Although bulk graviton fluctuations are suppressed in this limit, quantum inflaton fluctuations remain finite. Because reheating occurs on a surface of fixed inflaton value, these fluctuations become fluctuations of the conformal factor of the reheating metric.
